The First Hat
A hat maker finds the first label that sticks. Every chapter turns on a choice: wear it, hand it back, or give it a new name.
Dude & Dudette
Two travelers at the city gate trade their issued titles for the names they choose and leave a way through for the next travelers.
The Hatette Spin
The siblings discover how a rhyme and a suffix can take the force out of an insult. Their first workshop becomes a word lab.
Boy & Boyette
At the playground tournament, teams inherit their labels with their uniforms. Two competitors rewrite the entry rules.
Girl & Girlette
A crew builds a fortress with room for every voice, then must decide what to do when the gatekeeper wants a list of the right words.
The Box Police
The officers arrive with a broken ruler. The crew puts the ruler through its own test and finds the missing millimeter.
Pals & Palettes
A gray town lets visitors borrow names by the hour. Each chosen name returns a color and reveals a street paved over long ago.
Kings & Kingettes
The Crown Forge offers an inherited crown and a blank casting tray. Two rivals choose the tray and renegotiate who gets to run the forge.
The Mirror Fortress
Every reflection insists it knows the visitor. A route marked Z to A leads to Nowhere, where the mirrors lose the power to name people.
Rhythm of the Free
Four beats move a group across shifting bridges. In a Doggerland fantasy vault, a circle and a spiral tell them which way the water once ran.
The Hater Siege
The Box Police close in on the Crown Forge. The crew opens gates in all six realms and invites the people outside to write their own entry passes.
Unboxed
The old labels lose their grip. The crew learns which names they want to keep, which they want to trade, and which they can set down for good.
DONE.
A to Z and Z to A meet at the same gate. The first hat returns, and the character who wears it chooses its name in public.
